original.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds support for warmup configuration in DestinationRule's load balancing traffic policy, introducing duration, minimumPercent, and aggression fields to control warmup mode behavior.

decision.reason: [ev-c2809b3da7db] only says Istio added optional warmup settings (duration, minimumPercent, aggression) to the DestinationRule load-balancer traffic policy. It describes no environment state in which an existing setup is affected. The proposed condition flags every environment that uses DestinationRule v1beta1 or sets a loadBalancer. That is far broader than any real exposure. It also picks an API version (v1beta1) that the evidence never mentions. Because the evidence describes no consequence, it supports no exposure condition, so there is nothing valid to correct this to.
